preconditions.description: Number of destinations is between 2 and 100,000.
Number of Time Corridors is between n-1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, _ in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor connects two distinct destinations within the range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= e <= 10**9 for _, _, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: Energy requirement for each corridor is between 0 and 1,000,000,000.
Each pair of destinations is connected by exactly one corridor.

preconditions.expression: all(e1 != e2 for _, _, e1 in corridors for _, _, e2 in corridors if e1 != e2)

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of non-MST corridors.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(e_max, int) and 0 <= e_max <= 10**9 for e_max in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is an integer between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(e_max == max(e for a, b, e in corridors if (a, b) != (c_a, c_b) and (b, a) != (c_a, c_b)) for e_max, (c_a, c_b, _) in zip(output, non_mst_corridors))
postconditions.description: For each non-MST corridor, E_max(c) is the maximum energy of any other corridor not in the MST.
